about:
Idaho Custom Woodwork operates from Boise, Idaho, as a locally owned limited liability company. The shop has been active for over 35 years, building a reputation for custom furniture and full-service restoration. No founding year is publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named in available sources.

The company produces custom indoor and outdoor furniture in styles that include farmhouse, modern, mission, and live-edge river tables. Its workshop handles dining sets with extendable leaves, coffee and end tables, bed sets, dressers, nightstands, and small cabinetry. In addition to new builds, the team provides furniture repair, antique restoration, custom color matching, veneering, and rebuilding of damaged pieces with custom-fabricated parts.

Idaho Custom Woodwork serves both residential and commercial clients throughout the Treasure Valley and across Idaho. Customers range from homeowners seeking heirloom-quality tables to businesses needing refurbished seating or built-in cabinetry.

The owner emphasizes trust, craftsmanship, and integrity as founding principles, and the shop operates on an appointment-only basis to ensure personalized attention. The business has been recognized as the best furniture maker and restoration company for 2024 through 2026 by Business Rate.
